sentences: I look at the wall clock above the kitchen table and note that the time is exactly seven fifteen in the morning.
I set my alarm clock for six thirty each night before I go to sleep, pressing the button until the correct time shows.
I check the digital clock on the microwave to see how many minutes remain before the timer beeps.
I wind the grandfather clock in the hallway every Sunday evening, turning the key until the spring is fully wound.
I watch the cuckoo clock on the living room wall as the small wooden bird comes out to announce the hour.
I adjust the hands on my analog clock radio to the correct time after the power goes out during a storm.
I replace the battery in the kitchen clock when the second hand starts to move in uneven jumps.
I set the clock forward one hour in spring and back one hour in autumn for daylight saving time.
I press the snooze button on my bedside clock to get nine more minutes of rest before the alarm sounds again.
I listen to the steady tick of the pendulum clock in the study as I read my book in the evening.
I observe the quartz clock on the office wall and note that it keeps time with very little deviation each month.
I read about the atomic clock at the national laboratory that uses cesium atoms to measure seconds precisely.
I examine the clock face with its twelve numbers and two hands that rotate around the center point.
I watch the minute hand move slowly toward the twelve while the hour hand stays near the three.
I hear the clock chime four times at the top of the hour and then silence returns to the room.
I take my clock to the repair shop when the gears inside begin to grind and the hands stop moving.
I compare the time on my digital clock with the analog clock in the hall to see if they match exactly.
I set the clock tower in the town square to the correct time using the control panel at the base.
I use the 24-hour clock setting on my devices to distinguish morning and evening hours clearly.
I maintain a collection of antique clocks on a shelf, dusting each one and checking its movement weekly.
